title: Canadian Pudding Parfait
description: A layered dessert of silky Canadian pudding, fresh fruit, and a hint of zesty passion. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the Canadian pudding and zesty syrup until well combined.
Cut the passion fruit in half and scoop out the pulp and seeds.
In a glass or parfait dish, create a layer of the pudding mixture.
Top with a layer of fresh fruit.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of fresh fruit on top.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
